articles.title: Meta is paying creators in Stablecoins. Spending them is someone else's problem
articles.snippet: Meta’s decision to pay creators in USDC validates stablecoins as a mainstream disbursement tool, Joslyn suggests, but it also exposes the industry’s unresolved problem: moving seamlessly from digital dollars to usable local currency.

articles.title: America’s largest banks are building a new digital currency network to stop a massive deposit drain
articles.snippet: America’s biggest banks are launching tokenized deposits to compete with stablecoins, opening a new front in the race to become the dominant form of cash on blockchain networks.

articles.title: A crypto pioneer who turned a $20 million family stake into a billion-dollar fund doubles down on bitcoin
articles.snippet: Sourcing initial capital from his mother to build a $1 billion crypto empire, DFG CEO James Wo says market metrics do not support Tom Lee’s $250,000 ether prediction.

articles.title: Satoshi-era bitcoin at center of $285 billion lawsuit moves after 14 years
articles.snippet: The 1LwWt address received a legal notice from Salomon Brothers via Bitcoin's OP_RETURN field in July 2025 demanding the owner prove ownership by November 5, 2025.

articles.title: A massive hiring wave reveals trading firms are no longer viewing Polymarket as a niche betting tool
articles.snippet: While rising volume on Polymarket and Kalshi is attracting quantitative firms to prediction markets, they aren't focusing on event outcomes; rather, they're exploiting market inefficiencies for profit.
